previous_statement: Raw-call packaging and complete t_1 ledger. Form the complete record before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement. If m>1, record the Stage-1 tag; supplied input map w; named source C^{m+1}; explicit target corner/ambient A; base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; target pieces P_old,P_fresh; literal sum map v_raw obtained from v_old and v_fresh via their corner-to-A inclusions; its fixed amplification family obtained by summing the supplied families; target-ambient defect epsilon; and d_raw:=D_1*t_1. If m=1, record the Stage-1 tag and w; source C^2=C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}; base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; v_raw:=v_fresh and its supplied family; target-ambient defect L*epsilon; and d_raw:=C_pair*L*epsilon. The m>1 value D_1*t_1 is entered as a candidate record field before the inference, not assumed as an estimate: def-maincb-raw-call explicitly says that recording d_raw does not assert that the literal map is an extended inclusion or isomorphism. Nodes 1.2-1.4 supply complementary target projections, the old extended inclusion when present, and the fresh extended inclusion. Their projection, complementarity, and component-map defects are bounded by c_0^cb*epsilon, L*epsilon, C_co*(c_0^cb+1)*epsilon, or C_pair*L*epsilon; the recorded target-ambient defects are epsilon and L*epsilon. Each is at most t_1 because K_1 dominates its coefficient, and node 1.1 gives 0<=t_1<=e_1. Thus the explicit raw-call datum is complete before the external lemma is applied and meets every antecedent of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement at base scale t_1; its conclusion will certify the recorded candidate in the m>1 branch, while node 1.3 already certifies the m=1 raw defect.
new_statement: Conditional raw-call packaging, and explicit scope obstruction. Assume in addition that c_0^cb is a fixed finite nonnegative universal constant. Then node 1.1 supplies finite universal K_1 and positive e_call_1 with 0<=t_1:=K_1*epsilon<=e_1 and with K_1 dominating every coefficient used below. For m>1, record before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement: the Stage-1 tag; supplied input map w; source C^{m+1}; explicit target corner/ambient A; base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; target pieces P_old,P_fresh; the literal sum map v_raw obtained from v_old and v_fresh through their corner-to-A inclusions; the summed fixed amplification family; target-ambient defect epsilon; and the candidate field d_raw:=D_1*t_1. For m=1, record the Stage-1 tag and w; source C^2=C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}; base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; v_raw:=v_fresh with its supplied amplification family; target-ambient defect L*epsilon; and d_raw:=C_pair*L*epsilon. Recording d_raw asserts no estimate by def-maincb-raw-call. Nodes 1.2-1.4 supply the required target projections, complementarity, old inclusion when present, and fresh inclusion; conditionally on the added premise, their defects c_0^cb*epsilon, L*epsilon, C_co*(c_0^cb+1)*epsilon, and C_pair*L*epsilon, as well as the ambient defects, are at most t_1. Hence under that added premise this is a complete explicit raw-call datum meeting the antecedents of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement. The premise is not supplied by the root, any registered definition, or any of the six allowed externals, so this conditional construction does not establish the unconditional node-1/root claim.
